Techno-Functional Leader in Retail, Corporate and Investment Banking
Modernization, Client Onboarding, Digital Banking in driving digital
transformation across client onboarding, account opening, and channel
enablement. Proven track record of aligning complex technical roadmaps with
commercial objectives to evolve legacy core banking monoliths into cloud-native,
API-driven ecosystems in agile environment.
Strategic Architecture & Compliance Delivery: Expert in architecting API-first
strategies and RESTful microservices that convert intricate business
requirements into scalable, system-agnostic solutions. Successfully compresses
corporate client time-to-transact while ensuring strict adherence to global
regulatory frameworks.
Ecosystem Integration & Compliance: Expert at integrating mission-critical
subsystems—such as KYC/AML and Account Aggregators—into unified
ecosystems. I embed IT Audit and Regulatory governance into the product
lifecycle to ensure secure, compliant, and frictionless global workflows.
Global Delivery & Synergy: Proven ability to unify business, tech, and
compliance teams within multi-vendor, multi-geography environments. I lead
cross-functional global teams to transform high-stakes challenges into
measurable business outcomes through disciplined Agile execution and
customer-centric design and cross functional collaboration with stake holders.
